Enforce.Name: Require ammunition
Enforce.Hint: Weapons with the Ammunition property cannot attack without a selected ammunition, and the attack is blocked when none is left. The GM can turn the requirement off for a single weapon from the item sheet's header menu.

IncludeNpc.Name: Apply to NPCs
IncludeNpc.Hint: By default the requirement only affects player characters: monster weapons usually have no ammunition items, so their attacks would be blocked otherwise.

Notify.GmOnly: Only the GM can change this.
Notify.Failed: Could not change the weapon setting.
